description: İBB Birimleri Su Tüketimi is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesine ait müdürlüklerin su tüketim miktarlarını ve sözleşme bilgilerini içerir. Coverage: Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include IMM, water, water consumption. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
